hook.text: In Phoenix and San Francisco, you can hail a car with no driver. It arrives, picks you up, and drives.

buildup.text: Waymo's robotaxis use lidar, cameras, and radar to see 300 meters in every direction.

discovery.text: After billions of miles of testing, Waymo operates in limited zones with mapped streets and known conditions.

twist.text: The service only works in pre-mapped areas. An unmapped construction zone can confuse the system entirely.

climax.text: Waymo completes thousands of paid rides daily—but expanding to new cities requires remapping everything.

punchline.text: Robotaxis work—in the neighborhoods they've memorized.

quiz.question: Why can't Waymo's robotaxis immediately operate in a new city?
options: Every street must be pre-mapped in high detail first
